name: Al. Gifford
bio: Al. Gifford passed through Medora in 1884 and came down from Glendive in June 1885 saying he would settle in Medora if a South America plan fell through. By December 1886 the paper listed him among old-timers, married and living in Miles City.

moments.label: Weighed South America or settling in Medora

mentions: Al. Gifford stopped over a train Tuesday on his way to New York. He will return in two weeks.
Al. Gifford came down from Glendive yesterday. He has been thinking of going to South America but should this fail he intends to settle in Medora.
Al. Gifford is married and living in Miles City.  Miss Mary Brophy is at home in Mingusville.  A. W. Merrifield is in his old Canadian home and will return in the spring.  Wm. Paddo…
